entities.summary: Bademlik Mosque is a mosque built in the 15th century by Emir Hüseyin Bey in the center of Edirne province. Located in the Yeni İmaret neighborhood, the mosque is also known as Hıdırlık Mosque, Emir Hüseyin Mosque, and Emir Şah Mosque.
